qa_pairs.question: What are the standard working hours?
qa_pairs.answer: Our regular working hours are Monday to Friday, 09:00 AM to 06:00 PM (WIB), including a 1-hour lunch break from 12:00 PM to 01:00 PM.

qa_pairs.question: Does the company support remote or hybrid work?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we operate on a hybrid work model. Employees are required to work from the office on Mondays and Wednesdays, while working remotely on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays.

qa_pairs.question: What is the policy for overtime work?
qa_pairs.answer: Overtime work must be pre-approved by your Direct Supervisor via the HR Portal at least 24 hours in advance. Overtime compensation is calculated at 1.5x the hourly base salary rate.

qa_pairs.question: How many annual leave days do employees get?
qa_pairs.answer: Full-time employees receive 12 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accrued after completing the initial 3-month probation period.

qa_pairs.question: How do I request paid time off or sick leave?
qa_pairs.answer: Leave requests must be submitted through the HR Portal at least 3 days prior. For sick leave exceeding 1 consecutive day, a valid medical certificate (surat dokter) must be uploaded.

qa_pairs.question: Do unused annual leave days carry over to the next year?
qa_pairs.answer: A maximum of 5 unused annual leave days can be carried over to the first quarter (Q1) of the following year. Any remaining days beyond that will expire on March 31.

qa_pairs.question: What medical benefits are provided?
qa_pairs.answer: All permanent employees receive BPJS Kesehatan coverage and private outpatient medical reimbursement up to IDR 5,000,000 per calendar year.

qa_pairs.question: How do I claim medical reimbursement?
qa_pairs.answer: Submit your original receipts and diagnosis slip via the HR Portal under the 'Reimbursements' menu within 14 days of your hospital or clinic visit.

qa_pairs.question: What is the laptop allowance or provision policy?
qa_pairs.answer: Each engineer/developer is issued a MacBook Pro or High-Spec ThinkPad upon joining. Employees can request a laptop replacement or upgrade every 3 years.

qa_pairs.question: How do I report technical issues or request hardware accessories?
qa_pairs.answer: Submit an IT Support Ticket via Slack by sending a direct message to @IT-Helpdesk or emailing helpdesk@acmetech.com.
